title: ITK migration record
description: One downstream-visible change. Every field is optional; {} is a valid record.

title.description: One-line title. Defaults to the file-name descriptor split into words.

summary.description: One to three sentences, always visible in the guide.

details.description: Longer explanation in GitHub-compatible Markdown (CommonMark and pipe tables, explicit links).

categories.description: What kind of change this is.

impact.description: Approximate downstream impact; see the rubric in the template.

pr.description: PR that introduced the change. 0 is a drafting placeholder that CI rejects; -1 means no PR.

deprecated_in.description: Release that deprecated the old form, quoted.

removed_in.description: Release that removed (or will remove) the old form, quoted.

legacy_guard.description: Macro that hides the old form.

withdrawn.description: Retire a shipped record from the guide; explain why in details.

renames.description: Old-to-new names, rendered as a table.

examples.description: Before/after code. Either side may be omitted.
